products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS is a nonprofit organization that operates Lmarena.ai, a public platform it describes as an AI ranking and LLM leaderboard. The site invites users to chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across language, image, and code categories, with the stated aim of building a crowdsourced, community-driven benchmark based on real-world evaluation. The platform discloses that user conversations and certain other personal information may be shared with relevant AI providers or released publicly to support research.

The organization's tracked product, listed under the Chat and General LLMs category, is LMSYS Arena Models, characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use intended. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are currently associated with LMSYS in the held facts.
